scope: Internal source and static-analysis delta review; not an independent audit.
policy: Required by default; bool saved with each posted job; owner default affects future postings only. Both collection mutation wrappers enforce accepted owner and zero escrow/all bond reserves.
relocation: AGIType registry helpers and existing bounded ERC-165/balance staticcalls moved into NftEligibility. Existing public manager selectors and score semantics preserved; six linked libraries verified under Ethereum deployment limits.
reviewedProperties: NFT boolean packed into existing storage words; cancellation deletes it and missing job getter reverts; completed job policy remains readable.
ENS authorization, explicit owner/Merkle exceptions, blacklist, pause, capacity and bond checks remain separate from the conditional NFT gate.
No recheck at settlement, no NFT payout tiers and no settlement implementation changes.
Library mutation calls are reachable only through owner/empty-reserve manager wrappers; bounded staticcalls cannot reenter a write from NFT contracts.
New registry/default behavior requires new manager bytecode; old managers and their job storage are not modified.

observationsNoLongerReported.description: Loop condition i < agiTypes.length (contracts/AGIJobManager.sol#1594) should use cached array length instead of referencing `length` member of the storage array.
observationsNoLongerReported.reason: The two bounded loops now traverse a storage-reference library argument. Slither no longer emits this state-array optimization observation. The loops still read length directly; this is not claimed as a fixed vulnerability or a performed caching optimization.
